disclaimer: Prompt envelopes for engines. Not a claim that Lightricks, xAI, ByteDance, Kuaishou, OpenAI, Google, MiniMax, Black Forest Labs, Midjourney, Krea, Alibaba, Runway, or Comfy endorsed these wordings. Influence / coverage style only.

items.label: LTX 2.3
items.notes: Rewrite as LTX 2.3 video prose. Concrete camera move, lighting, duration-aware motion. No [Shot N] wrappers. No on-screen text unless the brief asks. Continuity with the Slate canon — do not invent a new scene.

items.label: LTX 2.5
items.notes: Rewrite as LTX 2.5 video prose. Same continuity as Slate. Explicit camera, motion, and diegetic sound. No [Shot N] wrappers. No on-screen text unless the brief asks.

items.label: Grok Imagine
items.notes: Rewrite as a single still for Grok Imagine. Photoreal cinematic, one frame, no on-screen text unless briefed. Do not describe a video timeline.

items.label: Comfy
items.notes: Rewrite for a generic local Comfy graph. Keep the Slate continuity. Concrete subject, light, lens. No workflow JSON.

items.label: Prompt server
items.notes: POST the Slate canon to LOT_PROMPT_SERVER /rewrite. Do not invent a rewrite if the server is down.

items.label: Kling
items.notes: Rewrite as Kling video prose. One clear action, camera move named in words, lighting, and a short audio cue. No parameter keys in the prompt. Continuity with Slate — do not invent a new scene.

items.label: Veo
items.notes: Rewrite as Veo prose: cinematography first, then subject, action, context, style. Dialogue as attributed quoted speech. No on-screen text unless briefed. Continuity with Slate.

items.label: Sora
items.notes: Rewrite as Sora video prose. One continuous shot, concrete motion and camera, no shot-list wrappers. Continuity with Slate — do not invent a new scene.

items.label: Seedance
items.notes: Rewrite as Seedance video prose. Bind subjects clearly, one primary change, camera and lighting concrete. No [Shot N] unless the brief is multi-event. Continuity with Slate.

items.label: Hailuo / MiniMax
items.notes: Rewrite as Hailuo/MiniMax video prose. Visual style, then action, camera vocabulary in words, diegetic sound. Continuity with Slate — do not invent a new scene.

items.label: Flux
items.notes: Rewrite as Flux still/video prose: subject, location, style, camera, lighting. Short and specific. Continuity with Slate. No workflow JSON.

items.label: Midjourney
items.notes: Rewrite as Midjourney still prose. Subject and light first, then lens and mood. No --flags unless the filmmaker wrote them. Continuity with Slate. One frame, not a timeline.

items.label: GPT Image
items.notes: Rewrite as a compact labeled still brief: scene, subject, details, constraints. Instruction-style restrictions. Continuity with Slate. One frame.

items.label: Krea
items.notes: Rewrite as Krea still/video prose. Concrete subject, light, camera. Continuity with Slate. No on-screen text unless briefed.

items.label: Wan
items.notes: Rewrite as Wan video prose for local Comfy. Concrete camera, motion, lighting. No [Shot N] wrappers. Continuity with Slate.

items.label: Runway
items.notes: Rewrite as Runway video prose. One action, named camera move, lighting. Continuity with Slate — do not invent a new scene.
